# Salesforce and Anthropic Announce Claudeforce: The #1 AI Meets the #1 AI CRM

![Salesforce and Anthropic Announce Claudeforce](https://www.salesforce.com/news/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/08/Anthropic-Partnership3.png?w=300)

*Expanded partnership brings Claude’s reasoning together with the data, workflows, business logic, actions, and governance of the Salesforce platform to power trusted enterprise action directly in Claude*

**SAN FRANCISCO, August 26, 2026 —** Salesforce and Anthropic are announcing Claudeforce, an expanded strategic partnership bringing Claude’s intelligence and reasoning together with Salesforce’s trusted enterprise harness to make its data, workflows, business logic, actions, and governance securely accessible to power agentic experiences wherever work happens.

The [Claudeforce](http://www.salesforce.com/claudeforce) partnership launches with Salesforce in Claude, a Plugin with 37 prebuilt sales skills that enable sellers and agents to reason over live revenue context, automate pipeline updates, and take governed action right from Claude — with the power of Salesforce directly where sellers work. The companies plan to introduce more integrations across Claude, Salesforce, and Slack, expanding each company’s use of the other’s technologies.

Salesforce in Claude is made possible by AIforce — Salesforce’s trusted enterprise harness that brings all your business data and workflows to any agent through MCP servers, APIs, and CLI tools, without complicated and costly integrations. Salesforce in Claude marks a new era of enterprise AI. For decades, enterprise software required users to manually navigate static UI to get work done. Now that agents can access the data, workflows, and rules directly, software is a system that powers every interface.

“We’re bringing together the world’s #1 AI and #1 CRM — the best of both worlds. Today, we’re launching Claudeforce, running directly on top of Salesforce via our new AIforce UI harness, Headless 360, Data 360, Tableau, and Slack. Here, the UI is the AI — allowing you to build custom apps dynamically and answer any enterprise question. Probabilistic intelligence alone doesn’t run a company, and deterministic systems don’t reason. By fusing Claude’s extraordinary reasoning with the trusted data, workflows, and governance every enterprise runs on, we’re delivering a dynamic interface that thinks, reasons, and acts. This is how every business will run.” – Marc Benioff, Chair & CEO, Salesforce

“We believe frontier intelligence should be safe, trusted, and deeply capable, which is why the world’s leading businesses turn to Claude for their most important work. Salesforce in Claude brings this same frontier intelligence into the systems where much of the world’s commercial activity happens. Through this partnership, companies can point Claude at the customer information and business context that they’ve been building in Salesforce for decades, and use it to actually run and grow their businesses.”  – Dario Amodei, CEO & Co-Founder, Anthropic

## **One partnership, intertwining AI built with data built on trust**

The Claudeforce partnership brings together the best of both worlds — Claude brings intelligence and judgment, reasoning, adapting, and deciding in real time. Salesforce provides the data, rules, and trusted workflows that turn that judgment into enterprise-ready action. The partnership contains:

###### **1. Salesforce inside Claude**

The Claudeforce partnership launches with Salesforce in Claude, a Plugin that understands the sellers’ entire revenue cycle and acts on it, giving them an AI CRO —  with 37 prebuilt sales skills including meeting prep, deal health review, and pipeline review.

These skills were built by Salesforce and Anthropic, engineered specifically to draw on Claude’s reasoning, agentic tool use, and generative UI — not generic CRM prompts wrapped around an API but the capabilities that extend what Claude can do. This includes an onboarding experience that reads a seller’s enterprise context — Salesforce, Slack, and any connector in Claude — to stand up a tailored dashboard with their accounts, pipeline, and live data surfaced in interactive views Claude generates.

No two companies run sales exactly the same, so Salesforce in Claude routes actions through Salesforce to help ensure business rules are always enforced when an action is taken. Setup is seamless. An admin connects Salesforce in Claude a single time, with authentication and permissions managed centrally, and every seller on the team gets access from day one — no per-user setup, no new permissions model to build, no re-auditing account by account.

###### **2. Claude inside Salesforce**

Claude combines multistep reasoning and complex task execution with Anthropic’s rigorous approach to safety and interpretability. Claude is available in Agentforce — serving as a reasoning model for the Atlas Reasoning Engine, powering Agentforce Vibes and Agentforce Coworker by default, and available in Agent Builder.

Through Amazon Bedrock, Claude is available within the Salesforce Trust Boundary, allowing customers, including those in regulated industries, to deploy domain-specific AI while keeping data and AI workloads secure.

#### Related

![Salesforce Agentic Enterprise Index 2025–2026](https://www.salesforce.com/news/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/08/781_0726_T15_Salesforce-Agentic-Enterprise-Index-Businesses-Are-Deploying-Nearly-4x-More_f.jpg?w=1024)

### [Salesforce Agentic Enterprise Index: Agent Deployments More Than Double Year over Year](https://www.salesforce.com/news/stories/agentic-enterprise-index-insights-2026/)

![Screenshots displaying different AI Agent interactions.](https://www.salesforce.com/news/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2025/10/How-Much-Free-Will-Should-Your-AI-Agents-Have_-2.png?w=1024)

### [How Much Free Will Should Your AI Agents Have?](https://www.salesforce.com/news/stories/ai-agents-free-will-determinism/)

###### **3. Slack: Where humans and agents work together**

Slack, the multiplayer work OS, brings people and agents together in the flow of work. By embedding Claude directly into Slack — the central workspace where teams already operate — Salesforce is bridging the gap between team dialogue and autonomous enterprise action.

Through this expanded partnership, Claude is the default model for Slack and serves as the intelligent backbone across every layer of the Slack experience: powering Slackbot to supercharge personal productivity by default, augmenting team decision-making via [Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag), and accelerating multiplayer coding as a founding partner for Slack Code. Rather than managing disparate tools, teams can now reason through complex decisions alongside Claude in Slack and instantly execute governed, high-value actions in Salesforce — all without ever leaving the flow of work.

###### **4. A partnership built on mutual adoption**

Salesforce and Anthropic are also strategic customers of one another. This reciprocal adoption makes each company both a builder and a customer of the hybrid architecture they are bringing to market together.

Salesforce is Anthropic’s preferred CRM and connects communication, workflows, and agents through Slack, its preferred multi-player work platform for internal teams. Salesforce Shield, Backup, and Sandboxes support security, resilience, and development. Building on that foundation, new capabilities, spanning headless experiences, connected data, and automation, will power stronger scale across customer engagement.

Claude is the AI model powering Slackbot for Salesforce customers and employees. Internally, Slackbot has transformed how Salesforce employees work, with Slackbot driving 8.1M hours of annualized productivity gains, up over 2x quarter-over-quarter. Claude is the default model for Slack AI, Slackbot, Salesforce in Claude, Headless 360, Agentforce Coworker, and Claude Code across Salesforce’s engineering organization. Salesforce will make Claude Code and Claude Enterprise available to all of its developers and knowledge workers as the company’s preferred AI assistant and productivity tools, and Claude is the first LLM provider fully integrated within the Salesforce Trust Boundary.

#### **Availability**

#### **About Salesforce**

Salesforce helps organizations of any size become Agentic Enterprises — integrating humans, agents, apps, and data on a trusted, unified platform to unlock unprecedented growth and innovation. Visit [www.salesforce.com](http://www.salesforce.com) for more information.

#### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic is a frontier AI company whose mission is to steer the trajectory of AI to advance human progress. We are best known for building Claude, the intelligence platform trusted by millions of people and businesses worldwide. Anthropic is a public benefit corporation — a for-profit committed to operating in service of social and public good — and controlled by a Long Term Benefit Trust, a group of independent experts in AI safety, national security, public policy, and social enterprise.

*Pricing and packaging are subject to change. Availability may vary by region and is governed by customer agreements. Customers should base purchasing decisions on products and services currently available.*

# What Does Salesforce Do?

![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/DF25-SF-251016-AS109155.jpg?w=750)
![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/themes/salesforce-blog/dist/images/hero-legacy-back.png)
![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/themes/salesforce-blog/dist/images/hero-legacy-front.png)

From your first customer conversation to your next big win, Salesforce's #1 agentic CRM helps you build stronger relationships, work smarter with AI agents, and transform your business into an agentic enterprise.

![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2020/09/jody20farrar-1.jpg?w=150)

## Share article

## Key Takeaways

Salesforce is the world’s #1 agentic [customer relationship management (CRM)](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/what-is-crm/) platform. It unifies your customer and business data, gives you trusted agents that work where your people do, and delivers results that scale. We call this the [Agentic Enterprise](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentic-enterprise/). When you become one, employees can focus on strategy and relationships while AI agents handle scale — a shift that opens new growth for companies of any size.

There are a lot of great AI models out there that are able to generate good answers. But good isn’t enough when your business depends on it. You need the right answer, which takes into account the deep knowledge and history of your specific company’s rules, data, and workflows, making it correct, auditable, and safe to act on. For example, a model can suggest a price, but it has no sense of your discount policy, margins, approval chain, or prior decisions. Salesforce knows that right answer, because all of that information lives within the [Salesforce systems](https://www.salesforce.com/products/what-is-salesforce/) you already use. We’ve spent 27 years building and improving them, which is why you get:

Salesforce is the only company that owns the customer data, business logic, and trust layer — which allows you to put AI to work safely, at an enterprise scale. So what does this look like? What are companies doing?

These are real use cases taking place at businesses worldwide right now. And Salesforce’s products and services are making it possible. Here’s what it looks like in practice: In the [State of Agentic AI in the Enterprise report](https://www.salesforce.com/products/resources/state-of-agentic-ai-in-enterprise/), organizations that have successfully deployed AI agents achieve ROI in about eight months. They also see 53% employee adoption, 29% CSAT improvement, and 29% reduction in operational costs.

![An overview of Salesforce awards and accomplishments, August 2026](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Salesforce_WDSFD_082626.jpg?w=4088)

## Table of contents

## **How does Salesforce work?**

Salesforce gives every employee, AI agent, and platform a single, shared view of your customer and business data. That matters because it lets agents and employees both work from the same trusted foundation. When that happens, agents can suggest next steps, automate work, and support customers with accuracy. And employees use that same reliable view of your data to move faster and focus on the judgment calls only they can make. It’s all possible because Salesforce’s AI is grounded in real business context, rules, and workflows, so it understands exactly what your business needs and how it operates.

![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/image_207e64.png?strip=all&quality=95)

Salesforce is built to be operated by humans, agents, and platforms across your entire ecosystem. We ensure that companies of any size can grow and adapt as their needs change — helping every business on the path to becoming an agentic enterprise. That ecosystem includes:

This ecosystem also reaches directly into the tools your teams already use every day, like [Slack](https://www.salesforce.com/slack/), and into the AI agents built with [Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) to act on your behalf. Here’s a closer look at how each one fits into that picture.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

## Get hands on with our products

In this interactive Salesforce demo, you’ll explore real AI use cases and solutions built for agentic enterprises.

![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/themes/salesforce-blog/dist/images/offer-block/offer-illustration-layout-four.png)
![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/themes/salesforce-blog/dist/images/offer-block/offer-accent-layout-four.png)
![](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/wp-content/themes/salesforce-blog/dist/images/offer-block/offer-cloud-layout-four.png)

## **What is Claudeforce?**

[Claudeforce](https://www.salesforce.com/claudeforce/) is the partnership between Salesforce and Anthropic that brings the #1 AI — Anthropic’s Claude — together with the #1 AI CRM, Salesforce. It puts your trusted business data, workflows, and governance to work inside the leading AI model, so the most capable AI can reason over the truth of your business and take action on it.

With Claudeforce, you get an AI CRO for every seller, with 37 built-in sales skills that are backed by 27 years of CRM experience. Claude can reason across Salesforce, ‪Slack,‬ and email to take action on the real state of your business. It works out of the box with your existing Salesforce permissions and business rules. Just connect Claude once and you get:

Probabilistic models alone can’t run a company and deterministic systems alone can’t reason. Claudeforce fuses Claude’s reasoning with Salesforce’s trusted data and controls to do both.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

## What is AIforce?

AIforce is Salesforce’s layer of trusted governance that brings all your business data and workflows to any agent through MCP servers, APIs, and CLI tools, without complicated and costly integrations. For decades, enterprise software required users to manually navigate static UI to get work done. Now that agents can access the data, workflows, and rules directly, software is a system that powers every interface. The first product of the partnership is Salesforce in Claude, focused on bringing your sales and revenue team’s data and workflows into Claude.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

## **What is Slack?**

[Slack](https://www.salesforce.com/slack/) is where work happens. It’s Salesforce’s AI-powered workspace — a searchable hub for communication, knowledge, and work tools, used by humans and AI agents alike. Slack integrates with Salesforce apps, and many other tools, to centralize your team’s activity. With scattered email chains replaced with conversations you can organize by topic, project, department, and more, you can keep track of current progress and find older discussions. But it’s more than just a place to chat.

Most AI agents only know what you tell them, but Slackbot understands how your business works. Since it lives in Slack, there’s no setup needed. Slackbot already knows each employees’ role, past interactions, and projects, and can access Google Drive, Salesforce, OneDrive, and other tools your team already uses. You simply give Slackbot instructions or ask it a question and it figures out which information and tools it needs to take action. That means every employee has an intelligent assistant to summarize past conversations, draft messages, generate meeting prep documents, automate tasks, and execute workflows.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

## **What is Agentforce?**

[Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/) is Salesforce’s AI agent platform where you can build, test, deploy, and govern AI agents that work 24/7, within the guardrails you set. And, it comes with pre-built agents that address your most pressing business needs right out of the box.

AI agents built on Agentforce can:

Because agents are powered by secure data, their actions are always relevant to the needs of your company and your customers. Agents adapt in real time as new information flows in, while operating within your business guardrails.

That real-time adaptability depends on Salesforce being reachable wherever agents actually work — not locked inside a single interface. That’s where Headless 360 comes in.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

![](https://play.vidyard.com/BnUu5y9ptP2UvynS2LzLFc.jpg)

## What is Headless 360?

[Headless 360](https://www.salesforce.com/headless/) extends every Salesforce product beyond the application. It makes your trusted business capabilities available wherever AI agents work. Think of traditional Salesforce like a bank, where you could only access your money by walking into one specific branch. Headless 360 keeps that same bank, same accounts and same rules, but it multiplies the access points.

The vault didn’t move, the access points multiplied. But their governance stays in place: fraud rules, transaction limits, and authorization checks still apply exactly the same way.

With Headless 360, Salesforce’s native permissions, sharing rules, and audit logs travel with the platform wherever it is accessed. This means developers can build with any coding agent, teams can deploy on any surface they already use, and IT leaders can govern and scale securely with native enterprise rules.

Whether it’s a service team resolving customer issues directly inside Microsoft Teams, a developer building a workflow in Claude Code, or a seller getting account updates via Gemini, it’s the same platform, same business logic, and same governance. Only the entry point is different.

Headless 360 isn’t the removal of the interface. It’s the liberation of the Salesforce platform because while the interface becomes flexible, the enterprise intelligence underneath stays constant.

So whether you use Salesforce within our platform, or pull it into your interface of choice, you have access to all of the apps, governance, and logic that has defined Salesforce for 27 years. Apps that help you run your enterprise and provide a level of service your customers deserve.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

## **Salesforce for customer service**

[Agentforce Service](http://www.salesforce.com/service/) connects customer service, field service, and employee service on one platform — uniting AI agents, human expertise, and trusted data for one seamless experience.

38%

improvement in customer satisfaction (CSAT)\*

30%

lower support costs on average\*

38%

increase in number of cases solved with Salesforce AI\*

Autonomous agents increase productivity by providing 24/7 customer service and generating responses to customer queries. And with [Agentforce Voice](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/voice/), customers can now have complex conversations with agents that know the full context of past interactions. When needed, these agents can hand off to a human rep, together with call notes that get reps instantly up to speed. Now, you can resolve cases faster, provide instant support, and have a complete and informed view of your customers at every interaction across self-service, field service, chat, SMS, and social messaging — all from one platform.

Let your team do what only they can do; Agentforce Service handles the rest.

([Back to top](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-does-salesforce-do/#top))

![](https://play.vidyard.com/YWivWyctCZa49mJFBKKmoG.jpg)

## **Salesforce for sales**

Sales is in our name. It’s how we got started, and we’ve never stopped finding ways to empower sales teams. [Agentforce Sales](http://www.salesforce.com/sales/) gives sellers agents that provide deal insights and sales coaching. It also has Piper, a pre-built AI sales

# The #1 AI meets the #1 CRM. Welcome to **Claudeforce**.

Claudeforce is a partnership between Salesforce and Anthropic to put your trusted data to work inside Claude — governed by the permissions and business rules your company already runs on. Our next innovation is Salesforce in Claude which ships as a plugin with 37 skills built for sellers, grounded in 27 years of Salesforce experience. It's available today for pilot customers and is planned for open beta in September 2026.

[Get updates](https://www.salesforce.com/claudeforce/contact/join-waitlist/?d=pb&pr=)

## The AI you want. The trust you need.

For decades, software gave us fixed interfaces: screens, menus, workflows designed in advance. The information was in there, but assembling it was your job — open the list, click into the account, read back through the history, hold it all in your head, and only then decide what to do. A seller could lose a morning before making a single call.  
  
Claude changes that. It reasons across your systems, reaching into your data, bringing the right answer and the right action instead of making you navigate to find it. This is a shift from software as the interface to software powering every interface.  
  
A model can reason brilliantly and still be a genius who's never seen your deals. Point it at your company and it can't tell a healthy deal from one about to slip, because it doesn’t know your pipeline, your accounts, or your history. That's what Salesforce in Claude is all about. Turn the connection on once, and Claude can reach across Salesforce, Slack, and your email to reason over the real state of your business and act on it.  
  
This past year, Salesforce and Anthropic have built together again and again, from Claude Tag in Slack to Claude in Agentforce, and most recently Claude as a launch partner for Slack Code, the space where engineering teams and agents build in the open. Each new capability had the same goal: put AI in the tools people already use, for engineers and knowledge workers alike. Claudeforce is bigger than any one of them. It's the moment the #1 AI and the #1 CRM start working as one, giving every seller an AI CRO.

## The #1 AI meets the  #1 CRM wherever you work

## Put Claude to work

### 

Your trusted data with your permissions and business rules, in the AI you want.

### 

Claude Tag is an AI teammate for Slack that acts like a human coworker. It handles collaborative tasks, remembers channel context, and automates workflows directly inside team threads.

### 

AI coding is now a team sport. Code channels bring software development out of private tabs, so teams and agents can write, review, and ship code together, in the open.

## Reasoning, meet the system of record

Viewing your pipeline is one thing, and plenty of tools can do it. But acting on it is harder, because it means updating records, running multi-step workflows, and moving a deal forward without stepping outside the rules your company enforces. No two companies run sales exactly alike, which is why Claude routes every action through Salesforce, so your rules are enforced.

With Claudeforce, we are building on Headless 360, a collection of Salesforce capabilities (data, apps, workflows, agents, and the governance around them) that AI can call directly over MCP, no user interface required and no custom integration work. For years that value was locked behind the interface: it lived in your data, your relationships, and your rules, but the only way to reach it was to log in and click through screens. MCP is what frees it, so an AI agent can work with it wherever you are. The same capabilities are open to any developer who wants to build their own, but through Claudeforce, you get a ready-made experience, built for sellers, that works out of the box.

It's also what lets Salesforce work outside its own interface — in Slack, and now in Claude, with the same data and the same answers you'd get in the native Lightning interface.  
  
For sales teams, this combination produces something new: an AI that understands your entire revenue cycle and acts on it. An AI CRO for every seller.

## See it in action

## Sales skills built in

**Put these 37 sales skills to work, from prospecting to close.**

These skills were built by Salesforce and Anthropic, engineered specifically to draw on Claude's reasoning, agentic tool use, and generative UI, not generic CRM prompts wrapped around an API, but capabilities that extend what Claude can do. This includes an onboarding experience that reads a seller's enterprise context, Salesforce, Slack and any connector in Claude, to stand up a tailored dashboard, with their accounts, pipeline and live data, surfaced in interactive views Claude generates.

## Start every morning with a clear plan

Ask what needs your attention today and get an action plan straight from your live pipeline: what moved overnight, what's at risk, and what to do first. You're ahead before the day starts.

## Generate plans to win any deal

Ask about any deal and get more than a health score. You  get the objections you'll hear and the plan to answer them, drawn from every call, email, and stage change on the record.

## Grow what you have.  Find what's next.

Salesforce in Claude finds the growth already sitting in your accounts, the expansions and renewals easy to miss, then turns your best new prospects into outreach ready to send.

## Be the most prepared person in every room

Walk into any call briefed on the whole account and the right next move, with the prep and the follow-up already handled. You show up sharp without the grind.

## Take action with governance built in

Engage with customers based on your Salesforce permissions. Get zero data retention on Sonnet, Opus  and Haiku.

## Salesforce is customer zero

Like every Salesforce product, we build on ourselves first. Salesforce in Claude started with our own sellers, and Anthropic's, wiring up MCP servers, writing skills, and managing auth by hand, one user at a time. It delivers that work out of the box for everyone. A plugin you install instead of a stack you assemble by hand. Our engineers built it alongside our own Account Executives, who piloted it on real pipeline, real accounts, real deals. And now, our customers get the same product that our sellers rely on every day.

President, Chief Revenue Officer, Salesforce

## Alexa Vignone

My sellers start the day with the pipeline review already done and the account history already there. That time goes straight back into customer conversations. We've never had a software rollout where reps asked for access this fast.

## Guardrails built in.  No new permissions model to build.

Every answer and every action runs through your existing Salesforce permissions and business rules. Claude sees what the user is authorized to see, and can do what that user is authorized to do, no more. There's nothing new to stand up, nothing to re-audit, and nothing to configure account by account. An admin connects Salesforce in Claude once, and it works for the whole team from day one.

On the write side, the controls are just as concrete, and you decide how they work. Claude can check with you before it emails anyone outside your company, or just send it once you're comfortable letting it. When it updates a record, it changes only the field it said it would. Humans direct. Agents execute. Salesforce governs.

Salesforce worked with Anthropic on Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which combine the privacy of zero data retention with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting serious misuse. Eligible customers will be able to keep activity data in cloud infrastructure they control, under their own encryption keys, access policies, and audit logging. When monitoring detects a pattern that needs attention, the alert goes directly to the customer for review, with no Anthropic human review required.

Enterprise Frontier Safeguards will roll out in phases beginning later this fall 2026. [Read Anthropic’s announcement and request access](https://www.anthropic.com/news/enterprise-frontier-safeguards) .

## Starting with Sales. Shipping more soon.

Salesforce in Claude is available to select pilot customers today, with plans for an open beta starting in September. The initial release comes with prebuilt skills for Sales, and we'll add more for other teams over the next few months.

# Salesforce y Anthropic anuncian Claudeforce: la IA número 1 se une al CRM de IA número 1

![Claudeforce](https://www.salesforce.com/mx/news/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/08/claudeforce-newsroom.jpg?w=300)

*La asociación ampliada combina el razonamiento de Claude con los datos, los flujos de trabajo, la lógica de negocio, las acciones y la gobernanza de la plataforma de Salesforce para impulsar acciones empresariales confiables directamente en Claude.*

**Ciudad** **de México – 26 de agosto de 2026** — Salesforce y Anthropic anunciaron Claudeforce, una asociación estratégica ampliada que une la inteligencia y el razonamiento de Claude con el confiable entorno empresarial de Salesforce para hacer que sus datos, flujos de trabajo, lógica de negocio, acciones y gobernanza sean accesibles de forma segura para impulsar experiencias basadas en agentes dondequiera que se realice el trabajo.

La asociación [Claudeforce](http://www.salesforce.com/claudeforce) se lanza con *Salesforce en Claude*, un *plugin* con 37 habilidades de ventas preconfiguradas que permiten a los equipos de venta y agentes razonar sobre el contexto de ingresos en tiempo real, automatizar las actualizaciones del *pipeline* y tomar acciones reguladas directamente desde Claude, con el poder de Salesforce justo en el lugar donde trabajan los vendedores. Las empresas planean introducir más integraciones en Claude, Salesforce y Slack, ampliando el uso mutuo de las tecnologías de cada compañía.

*Salesforce en Claude* es posible gracias a AIforce, el entorno empresarial confiable de Salesforce que lleva todos los datos y flujos de trabajo de su negocio a cualquier agente a través de servidores MCP, API y herramientas CLI, sin integraciones complicadas ni costosas. *Salesforce en Claude* marca una nueva era en la IA empresarial. Durante décadas, el software empresarial exigía que los usuarios navegaran manualmente por interfaces de usuario (UI) estáticas para realizar su trabajo. Ahora que los agentes pueden acceder directamente a los datos, los flujos de trabajo y las reglas, el software es un sistema que impulsa cada interfaz.

Estamos uniendo la IA Nº 1 y el CRM Nº 1 del mundo: lo mejor de ambos mundos. Hoy lanzamos Claudeforce, que se ejecuta directamente sobre Salesforce a través de nuestro nuevo entorno de interfaz de usuario de AIforce, Headless 360, Data 360, Tableau y Slack. Aquí, la interfaz de usuario es la IA, lo que le permite crear aplicaciones personalizadas de forma dinámica y responder a cualquier pregunta empresarial. La inteligencia probabilística por sí sola no dirige una empresa, y los sistemas deterministas no razonan. Al fusionar el extraordinario razonamiento de Claude con los datos, los flujos de trabajo y la gobernanza confiables sobre los que funciona cada empresa, estamos ofreciendo una interfaz dinámica que piensa, razona y actúa. Así es como funcionarán todos los negocios.

Creemos que la inteligencia de vanguardia debe ser segura, confiable y profundamente capaz, razón por la cual las empresas líderes del mundo recurren a Claude para su trabajo más importante. *Salesforce en Claude* lleva esta misma inteligencia de vanguardia a los sistemas donde tiene lugar gran parte de la actividad comercial del mundo. A través de esta asociación, las empresas pueden orientar a Claude hacia la información del cliente y el contexto empresarial que han estado construyendo en Salesforce durante décadas, y usarlo para operar y hacer crecer sus negocios en la realidad.

## **Una asociación que entrelaza la IA creada con datos basados en la confianza**

La asociación Claudeforce reúne lo mejor de ambos mundos: Claude aporta inteligencia y criterio, razonando, adaptándose y decidiendo en tiempo real. Salesforce proporciona los datos, las reglas y los flujos de trabajo confiables que convierten ese criterio en acciones preparadas para la empresa. La asociación incluye:

###### **1. Salesforce dentro de Claude**

Claudeforce se lanza con *Salesforce en Claude*, un *plugin* que comprende todo el ciclo de ingresos de los equipos de venta y actúa sobre él, brindándoles un CRO (Director de Ingresos) de IA, con 37 habilidades de ventas preconfiguradas que incluyen la preparación de reuniones, la revisión del estado de los acuerdos y la revisión del *pipeline*.  
  
Estas habilidades fueron creadas por Salesforce y Anthropic, y diseñadas específicamente para aprovechar el razonamiento de Claude, el uso de herramientas de agentes y la interfaz de usuario generativa; no se trata de *prompts* genéricos de CRM envueltos en una API, sino de capacidades que amplían lo que Claude puede hacer. Esto incluye una experiencia de incorporación que lee el contexto empresarial de un vendedor (Salesforce, Slack y cualquier conector en Claude) para crear un panel de control personalizado con sus cuentas, *pipeline* y datos en vivo presentados en vistas interactivas generadas por Claude.

No hay dos empresas que manejen las ventas exactamente de la misma manera, por lo que *Salesforce en Claude* dirige las acciones a través de Salesforce para ayudar a garantizar que las reglas comerciales siempre se apliquen cuando se ejecuta una acción. La configuración es sencilla: un administrador conecta Salesforce con Claude una sola vez, mientras la autenticación y los permisos se gestionan de manera centralizada. De esta manera, todos los vendedores del equipo tienen acceso desde el primer día, sin configuraciones individuales, sin necesidad de crear un nuevo modelo de permisos y sin volver a auditar las cuentas una por una.

###### **2. Claude dentro de Salesforce**

Claude combina el razonamiento de múltiples pasos y la ejecución de tareas complejas con el riguroso enfoque de Anthropic hacia la seguridad y la interpretabilidad. Claude está disponible en Agentforce, sirviendo como modelo de razonamiento para el motor Atlas Reasoning Engine, impulsando Agentforce Vibes y Agentforce Coworker por defecto, y está disponible en Agent Builder.

A través de Amazon Bedrock, Claude está disponible dentro del Límite de Confianza de Salesforce (Salesforce Trust Boundary), lo que permite a los clientes, incluidos aquellos en industrias reguladas, implementar IA específica para su dominio mientras mantienen seguros sus datos y cargas de trabajo de IA.

###### **3. Slack: donde humanos y agentes trabajan juntos**

Slack, el sistema operativo de trabajo colaborativo, reúne a personas y agentes en el flujo de trabajo. Al integrar Claude directamente en Slack -el espacio de trabajo central donde ya operan los equipos-, Salesforce conecta el diálogo entre equipos con la ejecución autónoma de acciones empresariales.

A través de esta alianza ampliada, Claude se convierte en el modelo predeterminado de Slack y actúa como la base inteligente de cada capa de su experiencia: impulsa Slackbot para potenciar de manera predeterminada la productividad personal, fortalece la toma de decisiones de los equipos mediante [Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag) y acelera el desarrollo colaborativo de software como socio fundador de Slack Code. En lugar de gestionar herramientas separadas, los equipos ahora pueden analizar decisiones complejas junto con Claude en Slack y ejecutar instantáneamente acciones de alto valor y sujetas a mecanismos de gobernanza en Salesforce, sin salir del flujo de trabajo.

###### **4. Una alianza basada en la adopción mutua**

Salesforce y Anthropic también son clientes estratégicos mutuos. Esta adopción recíproca convierte a cada empresa tanto en creadora como en cliente de la arquitectura híbrida que están lanzando conjuntamente al mercado.

Salesforce es el CRM preferido de Anthropic y conecta las comunicaciones, los flujos de trabajo y los agentes mediante Slack, su plataforma colaborativa de trabajo preferida para los equipos internos. Salesforce Shield, Backup y Sandboxes respaldan la seguridad, la resiliencia y el desarrollo. Sobre esa base, nuevas capacidades -que abarcan experiencias *headless*, datos conectados y automatización- permitirán alcanzar una mayor escala en la interacción con los clientes.

Claude es el modelo de IA que impulsa Slackbot para los clientes y empleados de Salesforce. Internamente, Slackbot ha transformado la forma en que trabajan los empleados de Salesforce y ha generado ganancias de productividad anualizadas equivalentes a 8,1 millones de horas, más del doble que en el trimestre anterior. Claude es el modelo predeterminado de Slack AI, Slackbot, Salesforce en Claude, Headless 360, Agentforce Coworker y Claude Code en toda la organización de ingeniería de Salesforce. La compañía pondrá Claude Code y Claude Enterprise a disposición de todos sus desarrolladores y trabajadores del conocimiento como sus herramientas preferidas de asistencia de IA y productividad. Además, Claude es el primer proveedor de modelos de lenguaje de gran tamaño (LLM) completamente integrado dentro del perímetro de confianza de Salesforce.

# Salesforce and Anthropic Announce Claudeforce: The #1 AI Meets the #1 AI CRM

![Salesforce and Anthropic Announce Claudeforce](https://www.salesforce.com/au/news/wp-content/uploads/sites/19/2026/08/Anthropic-Partnership3.png?w=300)

*Expanded partnership brings Claude’s reasoning together with the data, workflows, business logic, actions, and governance of the Salesforce platform to power trusted enterprise action directly in Claude*

**SAN FRANCISCO, August 26, 2026 —** Salesforce and Anthropic are announcing Claudeforce, an expanded strategic partnership bringing Claude’s intelligence and reasoning together with Salesforce’s trusted enterprise harness to make its data, workflows, business logic, actions, and governance securely accessible to power agentic experiences wherever work happens.

The [Claudeforce](http://www.salesforce.com/claudeforce) partnership launches with Salesforce in Claude, a Plugin with 37 prebuilt sales skills that enable sellers and agents to reason over live revenue context, automate pipeline updates, and take governed action right from Claude — with the power of Salesforce directly where sellers work. The companies plan to introduce more integrations across Claude, Salesforce, and Slack, expanding each company’s use of the other’s technologies.

Salesforce in Claude is made possible by AIforce — Salesforce’s trusted enterprise harness that brings all your business data and workflows to any agent through MCP servers, APIs, and CLI tools, without complicated and costly integrations. Salesforce in Claude marks a new era of enterprise AI. For decades, enterprise software required users to manually navigate static UI to get work done. Now that agents can access the data, workflows, and rules directly, software is a system that powers every interface.

“We’re bringing together the world’s #1 AI and #1 CRM — the best of both worlds. Today, we’re launching Claudeforce, running directly on top of Salesforce via our new AIforce UI harness, Headless 360, Data 360, Tableau, and Slack. Here, the UI is the AI — allowing you to build custom apps dynamically and answer any enterprise question. Probabilistic intelligence alone doesn’t run a company, and deterministic systems don’t reason. By fusing Claude’s extraordinary reasoning with the trusted data, workflows, and governance every enterprise runs on, we’re delivering a dynamic interface that thinks, reasons, and acts. This is how every business will run.” – Marc Benioff, Chair & CEO, Salesforce

“We believe frontier intelligence should be safe, trusted, and deeply capable, which is why the world’s leading businesses turn to Claude for their most important work. Salesforce in Claude brings this same frontier intelligence into the systems where much of the world’s commercial activity happens. Through this partnership, companies can point Claude at the customer information and business context that they’ve been building in Salesforce for decades, and use it to actually run and grow their businesses.”  – Dario Amodei, CEO & Co-Founder, Anthropic

## **One partnership, intertwining AI built with data built on trust**

The Claudeforce partnership brings together the best of both worlds — Claude brings intelligence and judgment, reasoning, adapting, and deciding in real time. Salesforce provides the data, rules, and trusted workflows that turn that judgment into enterprise-ready action. The partnership contains:

###### **1. Salesforce inside Claude**

The Claudeforce partnership launches with Salesforce in Claude, a Plugin that understands the sellers’ entire revenue cycle and acts on it, giving them an AI CRO —  with 37 prebuilt sales skills including meeting prep, deal health review, and pipeline review.

These skills were built by Salesforce and Anthropic, engineered specifically to draw on Claude’s reasoning, agentic tool use, and generative UI — not generic CRM prompts wrapped around an API but the capabilities that extend what Claude can do. This includes an onboarding experience that reads a seller’s enterprise context — Salesforce, Slack, and any connector in Claude — to stand up a tailored dashboard with their accounts, pipeline, and live data surfaced in interactive views Claude generates.

No two companies run sales exactly the same, so Salesforce in Claude routes actions through Salesforce to help ensure business rules are always enforced when an action is taken. Setup is seamless. An admin connects Salesforce in Claude a single time, with authentication and permissions managed centrally, and every seller on the team gets access from day one — no per-user setup, no new permissions model to build, no re-auditing account by account.

###### **2. Claude inside Salesforce**

Claude combines multistep reasoning and complex task execution with Anthropic’s rigorous approach to safety and interpretability. Claude is available in Agentforce — serving as a reasoning model for the Atlas Reasoning Engine, powering Agentforce Vibes and Agentforce Coworker by default, and available in Agent Builder.

Through Amazon Bedrock, Claude is available within the Salesforce Trust Boundary, allowing customers, including those in regulated industries, to deploy domain-specific AI while keeping data and AI workloads secure.

###### **3. Slack: Where humans and agents work together**

Slack, the multiplayer work OS, brings people and agents together in the flow of work. By embedding Claude directly into Slack — the central workspace where teams already operate — Salesforce is bridging the gap between team dialogue and autonomous enterprise action.

Through this expanded partnership, Claude is the default model for Slack and serves as the intelligent backbone across every layer of the Slack experience: powering Slackbot to supercharge personal productivity by default, augmenting team decision-making via [Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag), and accelerating multiplayer coding as a founding partner for Slack Code. Rather than managing disparate tools, teams can now reason through complex decisions alongside Claude in Slack and instantly execute governed, high-value actions in Salesforce — all without ever leaving the flow of work.

###### **4. A partnership built on mutual adoption**

Salesforce and Anthropic are also strategic customers of one another. This reciprocal adoption makes each company both a builder and a customer of the hybrid architecture they are bringing to market together.

Salesforce is Anthropic’s preferred CRM and connects communication, workflows, and agents through Slack, its preferred multi-player work platform for internal teams. Salesforce Shield, Backup, and Sandboxes support security, resilience, and development. Building on that foundation, new capabilities, spanning headless experiences, connected data, and automation, will power stronger scale across customer engagement.

Claude is the AI model powering Slackbot for Salesforce customers and employees. Internally, Slackbot has transformed how Salesforce employees work, with Slackbot driving 8.1M hours of annualized productivity gains, up over 2x quarter-over-quarter. Claude is the default model for Slack AI, Slackbot, Salesforce in Claude, Headless 360, Agentforce Coworker, and Claude Code across Salesforce’s engineering organization. Salesforce will make Claude Code and Claude Enterprise available to all of its developers and knowledge workers as the company’s preferred AI assistant and productivity tools, and Claude is the first LLM provider fully integrated within the Salesforce Trust Boundary.

#### **Availability**

#### **About Salesforce**

Salesforce helps organizations of any size become Agentic Enterprises — integrating humans, agents, apps, and data on a trusted, unified platform to unlock unprecedented growth and innovation. Visit [www.salesforce.com](http://www.salesforce.com) for more information.

#### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic is a frontier AI company whose mission is to steer the trajectory of AI to advance human progress. We are best known for building Claude, the intelligence platform trusted by millions of people and businesses worldwide. Anthropic is a public benefit corporation — a for-profit committed to operating in service of social and public good — and controlled by a Long Term Benefit Trust, a group of independent experts in AI safety, national security, public policy, and social enterprise.

*Pricing and packaging are subject to change. Availability may vary by region and is governed by customer agreements. Customers should base purchasing decisions on products and services currently available.*
